name: hirsel-desktop
description: Hirsel for Steam: the web build wrapped in Electron, with Steamworks.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run stage && npm run build:shell
scripts.build:demo: npm --prefix .. run build:demo && node scripts/stage-web.mjs --demo && npm run build:shell
scripts.package:demo:linux: npm run build:demo && electron-builder --linux dir -c.productName="Hirsel Demo" -c.appId=com.spaecbear.hirsel.demo -c.directories.output=release-demo
scripts.package:demo:win: npm run build:demo && electron-builder --win dir -c.productName="Hirsel Demo" -c.appId=com.spaecbear.hirsel.demo -c.directories.output=release-demo
